description: Publish, schedule, or draft a post across any connected Zernio social networks with support for platform targeting, media URLs, links, and scheduled times.

isDraft.description: Save as draft instead of publishing or scheduling

linkUrl.description: Web link to attach / preview in the post

mediaUrls.description: Array of image or video URLs to attach

platforms.description: Target platforms (e.g. ['twitter', 'linkedin', 'threads', 'bluesky']) or specific account IDs

publishNow.description: Set to true to publish immediately (ignored if scheduledFor is provided)

scheduledFor.description: Optional ISO 8601 date-time string to schedule for later (e.g. '2026-09-10T14:30:00Z')

title.description: Optional title (required for platforms like Reddit or YouTube)

name: zernio_publish_post
